reason: Test `constant_shape_512` first: it keeps the existing fallback and arithmetic, and fixed bounds may help compiler code generation, though the full A transpose remains and no gain is measured. Test `cache_conflict_layout` second: its padded stride may reduce set conflicts, but raises the active scratch footprint from 128 KiB to about 132 KiB on a CPU with 128 KiB P-core L1, and requires coordinated pack, load, and rewind changes. Neither proposal has measured performance evidence; the padding experiment also has greater bounds and correctness risk.
